snippet.title: Gothic 1 Remake | Making Of #01: The Essence of Gothic
snippet.description:
“The original Gothic was so popular and so unique at the time, that I feel like it deserves a proper remake.”

Join the team at Alkimia Interactive and take a look behind the scenes of Gothic 1 Remake, diving deep into the essence of the cult classic RPG. Discover how the devs are bringing the world of Gothic to life for a new generation while staying true to the spirit of the original. Are you ready to return to the Colony?

Keep your eyes peeled for the Steam Next Fest (February 24 – March 3) for more Gothic glamour!

Haltet beim Steam Next Fest (24. Februar – 3. März) die Augen offen für noch mehr Gothic-Geömmel!

Wyczekujcie wydarzenia Steam Next Fest (24 lutego – 3 marca), gdzie nie zabraknie Gothica!
 
Любители Готического гламура, внимательно следите за Steam Next Fest (24 февраля — 3 марта)
